sources.title: Optimal Stabilizer Testing and Learning with Limited Quantum Memory

method.question: How should coherent-memory width and copy/sample complexity be kept explicit in equivalent-useful-output quantum workload contracts?
source_reported_results: stabilizer testing sample complexity Θ(n-k) in the specified k-qubit coherent-memory model
non-adaptive stabilizer learning sample complexity Θ(n²/k) in the specified model
exponential lower bound for purity testing in a stated coherent-memory protocol
method.acceptance: Pin source theorem and assumptions; independently reconstruct the theorem; keep testing and learning distinct; only then run a preregistered small-n diagnostic with matched output quality.
falsifiers: source assumptions do not match the claimed task
small-n diagnostic contradicts the implementation of the stated theorem or reveals a model mismatch
apparent gain disappears under matched output quality and full resource accounting
